_comment: The retired set for skeleton-owned files: positioning lines that were taken
out of circulation and must not keep steering drafts from inside a reference
file. Owner of the values; retired-strings-sweep.py and its test both read
this file rather than restating any string (ASK-701, sp-36788323).
TIER IS DERIVED, NOT STORED. The sweep counts words with voiceloop.echo and
compares against echo.NGRAM: at or above the threshold a match is a lift and
fails the build; below it the phrase is short enough that ordinary prose can
reach it honestly, so it is reported and does not block. Storing a tier here
would let it drift from the module that owns what counts as a lift.
